national.note: sum of reported district votes; uncontested races not on the ballot add nothing (as in the calibration's national House vote)

coverage.note: share of races whose error, after removing the chamber's realized national miss, falls inside the central interval of the race-level error (region, slope and race-specific layers)

attribution.note: national, region and slope are the shared estimates in the layer table (one 2026 draw each; their z and p are the layer's, the same for every race they touch); race-specific is what is left, against t(df used) with the race's idiosyncratic SD. Two-sided p-values.
